chats.answer:
To run Home Assistant OS (HAOS) as a virtual machine on a NAS with a USB Zigbee stick, you need a NAS that supports:

Virtual machines — preferably KVM/QEMU with UEFI boot support.

USB passthrough — so the Home Assistant VM can directly access the Zigbee coordinator.

Enough RAM — 8 GB minimum recommended, 16 GB preferable.

x86-64 CPU — generally the easiest architecture for the official HAOS VM image.

The important distinction is that running Home Assistant in Docker is not the same as running Home Assistant OS in a VM. HAOS gives you the Supervisor, add-ons/apps, and a more appliance-like experience.

Best NAS options

Synology explicitly documents USB 2.0/3.0 passthrough for ordinary VMs, and QNAP documents USB passthrough through Virtualization Station. 
Synology Inc.
+1

UGREEN also publishes USB device passthrough instructions, and a DXP4800 GT tutorial demonstrates a working Zigbee stick. However, its separate hardware-passthrough documentation says whole USB-port passthrough is unsupported, so the exact model and firmware matter. 
Knowledge Center
+2

Models worth buying

QNAP TS-264 — 2 bays

Virtualization Station with USB passthrough. Good choice for a compact NAS running HAOS.

$489.00 at Best Buy

QNAP TS-464 4-Bay NAS Enclosure — 4 bays

More drive bays and flexibility for additional VMs and containers.

$639.00 at B&H Photo

UGREEN NASync DXP4800 GT 4-Bay NAS Enclosure — 4 bays

HAOS with a physical SONOFF Zigbee coordinator has been demonstrated on this model.

$659.99 at B&H Photo

My recommendation

For a USB Zigbee stick specifically, I would lean toward QNAP TS-264 or TS-464, or a compatible Synology Plus model. All still warrant testing the exact stick, particularly after VM restarts.

An alternative is to use an Ethernet/PoE Zigbee coordinator such as the SMLIGHT SLZB-06. This avoids USB passthrough entirely and lets you choose the NAS based on storage and VM performance.

One question: Do you already have a Zigbee stick (such as SONOFF ZBDongle-P/E, ConBee II/III, or Home Assistant Connect ZBT-1/ZBT-2), or are you buying that too?

The exact stick makes a difference to which NAS I would recommend.

A more reliable Zigbee option

If you are open to replacing the USB stick, use a wired Ethernet/PoE Zigbee coordinator such as the SMLIGHT SLZB-06. Then Home Assistant communicates with Zigbee over your LAN, eliminating USB passthrough issues.

One question: Which Zigbee stick do you have or plan to buy — SONOFF ZBDongle-P, ZBDongle-E, Home Assistant Connect ZBT-1/ZBT-2, ConBee, or something else?

That matters because a NAS supporting USB passthrough does not guarantee that every Zigbee stick works reliably after VM or NAS reboots.

chats.answer:
To run Home Assistant OS (HAOS) as a virtual machine on a NAS with a USB Zigbee stick, you need a NAS that supports both:

Virtual machines — capable of running the Home Assistant OS x86-64 image.

USB passthrough — allowing the VM to access your Zigbee USB coordinator directly.

Not every NAS that supports Docker can do this. Docker support alone is insufficient if you specifically want Home Assistant OS with Supervisor, add-ons, and the full HAOS experience.

My top choices are Synology Plus-series x86 models, QNAP x86 models, and UGREEN NASync x86 models, although USB passthrough support differs.

Recommended NAS models

UGREEN NASync DXP2800, 2-Bay NAS with Intel N100 Quad-Core C…

Best budget choice

$389.99

Intel N100, 8GB RAM, 2 bays. Runs HAOS in UGOS Pro's VM app. USB passthrough is documented, but compatibility with specific Zigbee sticks needs verification. 
raspberry.tips
+1

UGREEN NASync DXP4800 GT 4-bay NAS, AMD Ryzen Embedded R2514…

Demonstrated Zigbee setup

$659.99

4 bays, Ryzen processor. A published walkthrough demonstrates HAOS running with a passed-through SONOFF Zigbee USB stick. 
smarthomejunkie.net
+1

QNAP TS-264 2-Bay High-Performance Desktop NAS Enclosure

$489.00

2 bays, 8GB RAM. QNAP Virtualization Station supports Linux VMs and USB passthrough, subject to guest compatibility. 
QNAP (US)
+1

Synology DiskStation DS925+ 4-Bay Diskless NAS

$711.99

4 bays, AMD Ryzen. Supports Synology Virtual Machine Manager. USB Zigbee compatibility can be less predictable, so I'd verify your exact stick first.

Important USB compatibility caveat

UGREEN currently has conflicting documentation: its USB device passthrough guide describes the feature, while its hardware passthrough article says USB port passthrough is unsupported. These may refer to different mechanisms, but I would verify your model and firmware before purchasing. 
Knowledge Center
+1

For maximum reliability, you can use a wired Ethernet Zigbee coordinator such as the SMLIGHT SLZB-06 instead of a USB stick. That eliminates the VM USB passthrough dependency.

One question: Which Zigbee stick do you have or plan to buy — SONOFF ZBDongle-P, ZBDongle-E, Home Assistant Connect ZBT-1/ZBT-2, ConBee, or something else?

That matters because a NAS can support USB passthrough without successfully exposing a particular Zigbee stick to Home Assistant OS.
